title: Sentinel Managed Security: One Subscription per Client Organisation
content:
A client organisation holds at most 1 Sentinel Managed Security subscription. Every endpoint the client protects with Sentinel is enrolled under that one subscription, and running two endpoint agents on one device is not supported.

## The ordering condition

> A new subscription may be ordered only when the client holds no other Sentinel subscription whose status is ordered, deploying, active, suspended or notice given.

The test is made against the client's subscription records in the company's systems before the new order is recorded, and it is matched by client organisation: every Sentinel subscription held by the same client counts, whatever its tier. What the caller says about the client's existing coverage does not replace the system record.

## Which statuses count

| Status of an existing Sentinel subscription of the same client | Meaning of the status | Effect on a new order |
|---|---|---|
| Ordered | Signed; deployment has not begun | A new subscription may not be ordered |
| Deploying | Agent deployment to the client's endpoints is under way | A new subscription may not be ordered |
| Active | Monitoring is live and the term is running | A new subscription may not be ordered |
| Suspended | SOC monitoring is suspended for non-payment | A new subscription may not be ordered |
| Notice given | The client's signed notice of non-renewal or early termination has taken effect | A new subscription may not be ordered |
| Closed | The subscription has ended | Does not stand in the way of a new order |
| Cancelled | The order was cancelled before deployment began | Does not stand in the way of a new order |

## Points of judgement

**A client whose only earlier Sentinel subscription is closed.** No subscription of the client is in one of the five listed statuses, so this rule does not prevent the new order.

**A client with one cancelled order and one active subscription.** The active subscription is in a listed status; a new subscription may not be ordered, whatever the cancelled order shows.

**A client under notice.** A subscription in the notice given status still counts until it closes; while it is in that status a second subscription may not be ordered.
